A couple of notes from procurement/security:

- Security (Ravi) will need to understand network isolation options, data handling (KV cache retention), and KMS integrations.

Appreciate the forecast, Elena — that helps a lot. Quick notes from the SE side ahead of tomorrow's call:

- Based on the spreadsheet, peak concurrent streams and monthly token volume point to a 2x buffer for predictable latency. I'd propose a Dedicated pool sized for 4 reserved inference GPUs (NVIDIA A100-style baseline) with burst options of 2 additional GPUs for spikes.
- We'll review batching parameters and prefix caching to reduce per-token cost; there may be a recommendation to use quantized variants for lower-cost inference on non-sensitive workloads.
- For security: we support VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and audit logs. I'll bring sample retention windows and a short slide on network topology.

I'll prepare a one-page sizing rationale and share before the call (will attach to the calendar invite).

Marissa Cole
